nusmp.page.book_fire.crimson_lion_king: Crimson Lion King - a lion of flame at two and a half times the size runs twenty-four blocks, burning everything on its way, and explodes where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_fire.flame_armour: Flame Armour - the Crimson Lion armour for thirty seconds: Fire Resistance, Strength, and every blow sets its target alight with four extra damage.
nusmp.page.book_fire.phoenix_flare: Phoenix Flare - a phoenix of flame flies twenty blocks, burning everything on its line; allies near you are healed and a sunburst blooms where it ends.
